charts.title: TOI-125 c: orbits around TOI-125
charts.description: The orbits of TOI-125's planets in this map from above, to scale, with TOI-125 c highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: ExoFOP, via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname EXOFOP): P 9.1549418 d
